# Hermosa Software
> Software development company based in Uvita, Costa Rica.

## About
Hermosa Software builds web applications, React Native mobile apps, and provides staff augmentation.
We take ideas from concept to production for startups and enterprises.

## Services
- Web development (Astro, Next.js, headless Shopify)
- Mobile apps (React Native, iOS and Android)
- UI/UX design
- SEO
- Staff augmentation

## Products we built
- Tabstr: https://tabstr.net — hospitality tab and POS management
- KeepMore — Stripe fee optimization
- TicketManager — event ticketing platform
- LEDwristbands — event wristband experiences

## Notable experience
Developers on our team have shipped code for Universal Music, Tractor Supply, and Ford Motor Company.
